partners.mechanism_chain: KIF7 (HGNC:25567) —DISRUPTS→ Hedgehog signaling pathway (WP:WP45); Hedgehog signaling pathway (WP:WP45) —LEADS_TO→ Skeletal dysplasia (HP:0002658); PTCH1 (HGNC:9582) —DISRUPTS→ Hedgehog signaling pathway (WP:WP45); Hedgehog signaling pathway (WP:WP45) —LEADS_TO→ Basal cell carcinoma (HP:0002670).
